title: TabMail
excerpt: AI email for your existing inbox, on iOS and Thunderbird. Supports Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, and IMAP.
content_html:
Built for Thunderbird • open source

The open-source email client you trust,
now with AI superpowers

TabMail extends Mozilla Thunderbird — the privacy-respecting, open-source email client used by millions. We just make Thunderbird smarter and give it a fresh coat of paint.**

TabMail servers do not retain your email or calendar content.
When you use AI features, this data may be temporarily sent for processing but is never stored at rest.***
You can disable AI features at any time with a single toggle.

TabMail's Thunderbird Add-on is open source.
Explore the code, contribute, or build your own add-on features — all powered by our proprietary backend.

View on GitHub Learn more about Thunderbird

** TabMail is an independent project with no affiliation to or endorsement by MZLA Technologies Corporation or Mozilla Foundation.

*** Account information, usage data, and billing details are stored to provide and improve the service. Users may optionally share templates with the community. See our Privacy Policy for details.
